metadata.title: When you land 1 kill and Valorant just shrugs like ‘Did you mean to?’
metadata.description:
Not sure if I aimed or if Valorant just blessed me.
Enemy probably uninstalling from pure confusion.
Click if your aim ghosts but random kills still happen!

Hit like if your aim’s asleep but the kills still show up!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckykill #funnygaming #shorts

Instagram: @ganpatigamerboi
